selection_scope: one session explicitly named by caller
candidate_policy: all causal non-debris STARLINK candidates from prepare_adaptive_tle_position_inputs, retained only if a conservative regional normal-cap bound permits above-horizon visibility at queried epochs

regional_filter.criterion: retain if max p.dot(n) over either regional normal cap reaches the semi-minor axis at one queried epoch; uncertain candidates remain

state_layout.epoch_policy: regular grid covering all rounded receive-plus-integer-tau epochs
state_layout.array_layout: candidate, unique_epoch, xyz; ECEF position and velocity
state_layout.query_policy: round((track.times_s + tau) * 1e9), then interpolate on grid
